settings.heading: Made for the slow, strong hour
Move with us
settings.text:
Tell people who you are and why you make what you make. Two short paragraphs are enough: where it started and what you care about now.

Then say what is different about your pieces, in plain words a customer would use.

settings.heading: What makes it different
settings.text: Use this space for the one thing that sets your products apart: a fabric, a maker or a way of working. Say what it does for the person wearing it.

settings.heading: Meet us in person
settings.text: Tell people about a class, an event or a place where they can meet you. Add the dates, or point to the newsletter below.

settings.quote: “Add a few words a customer wrote to you. Short and real works best.”

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Say when orders leave and how long delivery takes to the places you ship to.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange?
settings.answer: Explain your return and exchange rules: how many days, in what condition, and who pays for shipping.

settings.question: How do I find my size?
settings.answer: Each product page has a size question form. Customers tell you their usual size and height, and the question arrives in your Formgong inbox.

settings.question: How should I care for my order?
settings.answer: Add washing and care notes that apply to most of your products.

settings.question: What do you do with my email?
settings.answer: Say what you send to subscribers and how often, and that they can unsubscribe from every letter.

settings.heading: Sign up for our newsletter
settings.note: By signing up you agree to our privacy policy. Unsubscribe any time.
